title: High-efficiency decontamination of pharmaceutical wastewater from γ-In2Se3/MoS2/graphene composite driven by broad-spectrum absorption spanning ultraviolet to near-infrared irradiation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30793-30803
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05282C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xinyang Li, Zhigang Ruan, Ruimin Zhang, Junchuan Wang, Huayan Si
A novel, wide-spectrum responsive γ-In2Se3/MoS2/graphene composite material is introduced, which shows superior degradation efficiency against a diverse range of antibiotic pollutants. The superior photocatalytic performance mechanism is proposed.
